reuse.why: Changes only the existing shared getRangedAmount/getExpectedAmount helpers that all planning consumers already call, reusing getApproxNumberThreshold.

duplication.why: No new logic is duplicated; the rule is edited in its single definition and the tests are updated.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the tree defines the expected-amount rule.

scope.why: Only the two helper bodies, their comments, one stale comment and the matching tests change.

maintainability.why: Math.min and amount - threshold express 'lowest value allowed' directly and are easy to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All consumers keep going through getExpectedAmount/getRangedAmount.
